learner_operation: Identify rank from the column-space basis or nullity from independent coefficient vectors; determine column count n; compute its complementary dimension using rank + nullity = n; select that integer.

fixed_features.justification: All 15 supplied practice questions use this contract.
Observed source difficulty split supports these inference paths.

coverage.result: 12/15 parameter/bank replays; three n=5 moderate cases rejected. One replay reorders x2-x1 as -x1+x2, an algebraically faithful normalization.

delivery.result: 64 raw easy -> 56 accepted; exact batch 5 -> 5. Bank-shape leakage survives, and the exact batch rule scores 5/5 before/after delivery. Every selected staged batch record is bypassable in the simulated positive-easy selection scenarios.

limitations: Finite audit, not an exhaustive search for every shortcut.
Live policy, learner history and future generated entity IDs were not captured; selection support is conditional on stated scenarios.
Publication preparation absent; shared read-only filtering used with basis 5443.
UI shuffles positions; numeric-order strategies remain applicable.
